A settings backup has been saved. Registration updates the selected user and clock and may replace that user’s previous app association. Existing readings, birthdays, and other settings are kept.

To read without registering, cancel and use Connect.

Independent app for importing blood pressure readings over Bluetooth. Tested with Omron X7 Smart AFib (HEM-7380T1-EOSL); other monitors are untested. No Omron code is included.

Readings are stored on this phone by default. Optional HTTP forwarding sends new readings to your chosen server only if configured. With local history off, readings wait in a temporary upload queue until the server accepts them. Optional Health Connect export requires your permission. Deleting local readings does not delete copies in Health Connect or on external servers. Export before uninstalling to keep your data.

History and memory imports are read-only. Registration and clock changes require confirmation. Advanced options include memory and diagnostic exports, which may contain health and identifying data.

Start measurements on the monitor. An irregular pulse flag is not an AFib result.

Delete %2$s readings and their notes for %1$s across all dates? History filters do not limit this action.\n\nMonitor memory and existing Health Connect copies are kept. Saved monitors, pairing, backups, and settings are kept. Automatic imports will not restore deleted readings; importing monitor history manually can restore them.
